biotools.summary: HoneyBee is an open-source framework for processing and analyzing multimodal oncology data, including radiology, pathology, and clinical data. It generates consistent, high-quality embeddings using domain-specific foundation models and enables downstream applications like survival prediction and patient similarity retrieval.
